newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Mobutu remains in Rabat hospital after operation.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu remains in Rabat hospital after operation.

text.p: The ailing former leader of Zaire, Mobutu Sese Seko, remained in a hospital in the Moroccan capital on Monday after his weekend operation and surrounded by tight security.
A senior Moroccan official said Mobutu was still in Avicenne hospital but he had no information on his state of health or programme.
Mobutu, 66 and suffering from prostate cancer, had an operation on Saturday for serious bleeding complications.
On Sunday, a doctor told Reuters by telephone: "He is well for the moment."
Security staff on Monday ordered a Reuters correspondent to leave on the hospital's fifth floor, where Mobutu had been admitted to the cardiology unit.
Hospital staff answering the telephone denied that Mobutu was even on the list of patients in the hospital.
